description: Woody climber; branchlets spiny, puberulous to tomentose, glabrescent, with a few scattered glandular hairs. Stipules 3–8 by 1–4 mm, half hastate-half cordate, puberulous. Leaves: rachis 6–14.5 em; petiole 1.7–4 cm; gland 0.5–1.5 cm above the base in the lower half or at the middle of the petiole; pinnae (3–)6–9 pairs, (2–)4–7.5 cm; glands just below the junctions of the 1–2 distal pairs; leafets (9–)13–33 pairs per pinna, opposite, chartaceous, sessile, (6–)6.5–11.5 by 2–3 mm, asymmetrically oblong, base asymmetrically truncate, apex rounded (rarely broadly acute) both surfaces glabrous, margins faintly ciliate; main vein marginal at the base, not parallel to the upper margin; ca 2–3 accessory veins ascending from the base; lateral veins prominent to prominulous below, forming a reticulate pattern of venation. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled. Flowers in heads; floral bracts 1.2 mm, spathulate, not projecting beyond the flowers in bud. Calyx 1.5–2.5 mm; tube glabrous; teeth 5, 0.7–1 mm, ovate-elliptic, acute, glabrous to faintly puberulous. Corolla 2.2–3 mm; tube glabrous; lobes 5.1–1.5 mm long, ovate to elliptic, acute, glabrous. Ovary 1 mm, sericeous, stipitate; stipe 1 mm. Pod 9.5–13 by 1.8–2.5 cm, oblong, flat, brown, rigidly chartaceous, glabrous with prominulous, transverse veins and distinct marks over the seeds. Seeds 9–9.5 by 7–7.5 mm, broadly elliptic, flat; pleurogram ca 5–6 by 2.5–3 mm, narrowly elliptic.

description: A straggling shrub or woody climber; branchlets spiny, faintly puberulous to glabrous, glabrescent, without glandular hairs. Stipules ca 2–3 by 1 mm, filiform, sericeous to woolly, early caducous. Leaves: rachis 10–20 cm, petiole 2.2–6 cm; gland ca 0.3–1 cm above the base, in the lower half of the petiole; pinnae 6–8(–13) pairs, 3.5–9.5 cm; glands below the junctions of the 1–3 distal pairs; leaflets (9–)11–22(–27) pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, chartaceous, (5–)6–15 by (1.5–)2–5.5 mm, oblong to subfalcate, base asymmetrical, truncate behind rounded in front; apex asymmetrically acute, sharply pointed, bent forwards; upper surface glabrous, lower surface glabrous to faintly adpressedly puberulous, margins often ciliate; main vein central at the base but running excentrically towards the apex; 3–4 prominent accessory veins, ascending from the base; lateral veins prominent beneath. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled. Flowers in heads; floral bracts 1.2–1.5 mm, spathulate not projecting beyond the flowers in bud. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, tube glabrous or rarely faintly puberulous; lobes 5, 0.3–0.5 mm, ovate acute, glabrous rarely faintly puberulous. Corolla 2–3 mm, tube glabrous, lobes (0.5–)1 mm, ovate-elliptic, acute, glabrous. Ovary 0.8–1 mm, puberulous to velutinous; stipe ca 1.5 mm. Pod (immature) 15.5–17.5 by 1–2 cm, oblong with slightly sinuate margins, flat, brown, chartaceous, glabrous, eglandular, with prominent veins and marks over the seeds. Seeds (not seen).

description: Woody climber or straggling shrub up to ca 20 m long; branchlets spiny, light brown, glabrous, without glandular hairs. Stipules ca 3–4 mm, filiform, early caducous. Leaves evenly scattered along the stem; rachis (5–)6–11(–13) cm; petiole 1.7–3.5 cm; gland in the lower half of the petiole (most often absent), ca 1 cm above the base, pinnae (3–)5–6(–7) pairs, (2–)4–9(–9.5) cm; glands between the junctions of the 1–4 distal pairs; leaflets ca (15–)20–40 per pinna, alternate, sessile, 5–15 by (1.5–)2.5–6 mm, ± broadly falcate; base truncate, ± symmetrical; apex asymmetrically rounded to truncate, mucronate-apiculate; both surfaces glabrous or with a few scattered hairs; main vein starting 1 centrally, not parallel to the upper margin, ca 3 accessory veins ascend from the base; lateral veins prominent, forming a reticulate pattern. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled. Flowers in heads; floral bracts 2–3 mm, filiform, projecting beyond the flowers in bud. Calyx 1.8–2 mm, tube with a few scattered hairs; lobes 5, 0.5–0.8 mm, broadly ovate, acute with few scattered hairs. Corolla 2.1–3 mm, glabrous; lobes 5; 0.9–1.5 mm, elliptic, acute, glabrous. Ovary ca 0.5–0.8 mm, glabrous, stipe 0.7–0.8 mm. Pod 10 by 0.8–1.8 cm, oblong with sinuate margins, fat, brownish, chartaceous, glabrous, with prominulous, parallel venation, vertical on the sutures; distinct marks over the seeds; dehiscing along both sutures. Seeds 7.5–8.5 by 7 mm, broadly elliptic; pleurogram ca 6 by 3 mm, elliptic.

description: Woody climber, scandent shrub or, rarely a low tree; branchlets spiny, velutinous to tomentose, glabrescent, without glandular hairs. Stipules ca 3–8 by 1.5–6 mm, cordate, often slightly caudate, faintly puberulous to woolly, caducous. Leaves evenly scattered along. the stem; rachis 6–16 cm; petiole (1.2–)1.5–5.2 cm; gland at the middle, 0.4–2.7 cm above the base; pinnae (4–)5–10 pairs, (15–)2–9 cm, glands at the junctions of the 1–3 distal pairs; leaflets (most often with a very wrinkled appearance when dried) 10–35 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 13.5–11.5(–13.5) by 0.8–3(–4.8) mm, ± narrowly oblong; base asymmetrically truncate; apex asymmetrically rounded to sharply acute, mucronate–apiculate, always bent forwards; both surfaces glabrous to sericeous, margins nearly always ciliate; main vein marginal at the base, not parallel to the upper margin, often 2 or more accessory veins at the base; lateral veins forming a dense, conspicuous, reticulate pattern. Inflorescence mostly axillary not panicled, rarely panicled. Flowers in heads, floral bracts 0.5–1 mm not projecting beyond the flowers in bud. Calyx 2–3.2 mm; tube glabrous to puberulous; teeth 5, irregular in size, 0.1–0.5(–0.9) mm long, triangular to ovate, acute, glabrous to puberulous. Corolla (only slightly longer than the calyx) (2.3–)3–4 mm, tube glabrous; lobes 5, 0.5–1 mm, ovate to ovate-oblong, acute, glabrous. Ovary 0.8–1.5 mm, glabrous to–sericeous, stipitate; stipe 1–1.5 mm. Pod 10–15 by 1.7–2.7 cm, oblong, often with sinuate margins, thick, fleshy, very wrinkled when dried, glabrous, venation inconspicuous, seeming to be segmented, and often falling apart in 1-seeded segments; dehiscent? Seeds 6.5–11 by 4.5–8 mm elliptic to orbicular, often of irregular shape, flat; pleurogram ca 5–10 by 3–6.9 mm, elliptic, ornamented.

description: Shrub up to 4 m high; branchlets greyish, glabrous; stipular spines up to 2.2 cm, straight or hooked; no shoot-dimorphy observed. Leaves: rachis 6–12 cm; petiole 0.9–2 cm, gland 0.6–0.9 cm above the base; pinnae 6–11 pairs, 1.3–3.5 cm; glands just below the 2–3 distal pairs; leaflets 21–29 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 3–4.5 by ca 1 mm, narrowly oblong; base asymmetrical, truncate/rounded, apex obtuse, symmetrical, both surfaces glabrous; main vein slightly excentric, nearly parallel to the upper margin, lateral veins hardly conspicuous. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled, bearing the involucel below the middle. Flowers in heads; floral bracts 1 mm, spathulate, ciliate. Calyx 1 mm, glabrous, teeth 5, 0.1–0.2 mm, broadly triangular, acute. Corolla 2.5–2.8 mm, glabrous, lobes 5, 0.7–0.8 mm, ovate-elliptic, acute. Stamens numerous. Ovary 1.5 mm long, glabrous; stipe 0.4 mm. Pod 5.5–9 by 1.5–1.8 cm, oblong, slightly curved, flat, brownish to yellowish, chartaceous, glabrous, prominently reticulately veined, with two submarginal ridges parallel to the margins, elastically dehiscent along both sutures; inside filled with a reddish pulp around the seeds. Seeds 3.5–6 mm, ellipsoid, slightly curved, flat, 1 mm thick, pleurogram ca 3 by 1.3 mm, oblong.

description: Deciduous shrub up to ca 4 m high; branchlets glabrous, brown-grey; stipular spines up to ca 3 cm, straight; leaves, lateral branches and peduncles often crowded on short-shoots. Leaves: rachis ca 4–6 cm; petiole 1–1.3 cm, gland in the upper half of the petiole, ca 0.8 cm above the base; rachis-glands not observed; pinnae 2–7 pairs, 1.5–3 cm long; leaflets opposite, sessile ca 10–21 pairs, 2–7 by 0.8–1.8 mm, oblong; base truncate, apex asymmetrically acute, mucronate; both surfaces glabrous; main vein excentric, lateral veins conspicuous, raised beneath. Inflorescence: peduncles axillary up to ca 5 together, 2.5–3.5 mm, bearing the involucel apically, just below the flowering head; heads of sessile flowers each subtended by ca 1 mm, spathulate, hairy bracts. Calyx ca 1.3 mm, tube glabrous; teeth 5, ca 0.2 mm, triangular, acute, glabrous. Corolla ca 2.5 mm, tube glabrous; lobes 5, ca 0.5 mm, elliptic, acute. Stamens numerous. Ovary ca 1.5 mm, subsessile, densely puberulous. Pods ca 1–2 cm diam, 4–7.5 cm long, straight or slightly curved, subterete and turgid, dark-brown to blackish, chartaceous, glabrous; veins and marks over the seeds inconspicuous; indehiscent. Seeds 7–8 by 5.5 mm, elliptic, only slightly compressed; pleurogram 6.5–7 by 4 mm, elliptic.

description: Deciduous tree up to ca 20 m high; branchlets glabrous, greyish; stipular spines erect-patent up to ca 6 cm; leaves, lateral branches and panicles often crowded on short shoots. Leaves: rachis (1–)–18 cm; petiole 1–5 cm; gland often absent, if present ca 1.1 cm above the base, between the junctions of the proximal pair of pinnae, rachis-glands just below the junctions of the 1–3 distal pairs of pinnae; pinnae (1–)2–4(–5) pairs, 4–12 cm, leaflets 4–13 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, (6–)12–35 by (2–)3–16 mm, narrowly oblong to elliptic; base rounded to cuneate, asymmetrical; apex broadly rounded to truncate, often emarginate and mucronate; both surfaces faintly puberulous to glabrous; lower surface with prominent, pinnate-digitate veins, main vein excentric, often 2–5 distinct veins arching upwards from the base, running parallel to the margin, the principal veins connected by lateral veins. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled, bearing the involucel in the lower half or near the middle. Flowers (4–5-merous) in heads, floral bracts 0.8–1 mm, spathulate. Calyx 0.9–1.1 mm, tube glabrous, teeth 0.1–0.2 mm, inconspicuous, obtuse, margins densely puberulous to very faintly ciliate. Corolla 1.8–2 mm, glabrous; lobes 0.3–0.5 mm, ovate, acute, glabrous. Stamens 15–22. Ovary 1 mm, velutinous–puberulous, sessile or subsessile. Pad (6–)10–13 by 1.1–1.2 cm, strap-shaped, straight or subfalcate to somewhat contorted, flat, brown, coriaceous, glabrous with prominent reticulate venation and prominent marks over the seeds, dehiscing along both sutures. Seeds 5.5 by 4.8–5 mm, suborbicular, biconvex, pleurogram ca 4 by 3.3 mm, suborbicular.

description: Deciduous tree up to 10 m; branchlets terete, tomentose, glabrescent; stipular spines up to 2.5 cm long, straight; young leaves and inflorescences on short shoots. Leaves: rachis 3.5–8.5 cm; petiole 0.6–1.5 cm; gland just below the junctions of the proximal pair of pinnae, rachis-glands below the junctions of the distal pair to all the pairs of pinnae; pinnae (4–)6–13 pairs, (0.5–)3–4.2 cm long; leaflets ca 6–25 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 3–11 by 0.5–1.7 mm, subfalcate to oblong, base asymmetrically truncate; apex asymmetrically obtuse/mucronate to acute/sharply apiculate; both surfaces faintly puberulous; main vein starting marginally at the base, not parallel to the upper margin, lateral veins inconspicuous to prominulous, no accessory, ascending, lateral veins visible. Inflorescence peduncles panicled, bearing the involucels below the middle. Flowers in heads, floral bracts 1–1.3 mm, spathulate to spoon-shaped. Calyx 0.8–1.2 mm long, tube densely puberulous to sericeous, teeth 0.1–0.2 mm long, ovate to broadly triangular-ovate, acute, sericeous. Corolla 1.2–2 mm long, tube densely puberulous to faintly sericeous, lobes ca 0.4–0.9 mm long, ovate to elliptic, acute. Stamens 20–25. Ovary 1 mm long, faintly puberulous, subsessile (stipe less than 0.1 mm long). Pod 7–12 by 0.9–1 cm, 0.3 cm thick, ligulate and often falcate, dark–brown, woody, woolly to tomentose when young, glabrescent, with inconspicuous venation; valves segmented inside between the seeds. Seeds 5.5–6.5 by 4–5 mm, flat, very variable in shape, orbicular to ellipsoid or trapezoid, often with a straight side towards the segment; pleurogram ca 4–5 by ca 2.5–3 mm.

description: Woody climber; branchlets spiny brown to red-brown, glabrous, without glandular hairs. Stipules ca 4–5 by 15 mm, ovate-oblong, acute, glabrous. Leaves evenly scattered along the stem; rachis 5.5–13 cm; petiole 2.5–7 cm, gland in the lower half of the petiole ca 0.6 cm above the base; pinnae 3 pairs, up to 10 cm; glands between the junctions of the pinnae; leaflets up to 7 pairs per pinna, opposite, chartaceous; sessile; 8–75 by 5–28 mm, asymmetrically subtrapezoid to obliquely obovate; base asymmetrically half truncate-half rounded; apex asymmetrically acute; both surfaces glabrous; main vein starting centrally, not parallel to the upper margin; ca 4 accessory veins ascending from the base, lateral veins prominent, forming a lax reticulated pattern. Inflorescence: pedunculate heads. Flowers [acc. to Craib (1927)]. Calyx ca 1.6 mm. Corolla ca 2.5 mm. Pod 10–14 by 3–6 cm, oblong, with sinuate margins, flat, red-brown, rigidly chartaceous, glabrous, with numerous, prominent, transverse, parallel veins, with distinct marks over the seeds. Seeds 11–18.5 by 6.5–10 mm, elliptic, flat; pleurogram-up to 13 by 4 mm, oblong.

description: Woody spiny climber, young branches puberulous, ± glandular hairy, glabrescent. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled. Flowers in heads; floral bracts ca 1 mm, spathulate-ovate, not projecting beyond the flowers in bud. Ovary hairy, stipitate.

description: Woody climber or ± scandent shrub; branchlets spiny. Stipules 3–5 by 1–1.5 cm (ovate-) lanceolate, cuspidate, tomentose to woolly. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled or solitary to 4 together in the upper leaf-axils. Flowers in heads; floral bracts 0.8–1.5 mm, spathulate, not projecting beyond the flowers in bud. description: Woody climber, branchlets spiny, puberulous to tomentose, glabxescent, in younger parts densely covered with glandular hairs. Stipules 1.5–2.5 by 0.4–0.8 mm, filiform, puberulous to tomentose. Leaves: rachis 9–16 cm; petiole 1–2.2 cm; gland at or above the middle of the petiole, 0.6–1.2 cm above the base, substipitate to stipitate; pinnae (12–)17–33 pairs, (1–)1.3–3.8 cm, glands between the junctions of the 8–14 distal pairs, stipitate; leaflets 25–67 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 1.5–3.5(–4) by 0.3–0.5 mm, linear-oblong; base asymmetrically truncate, apex broadly acute to subobtuse, straight or only slightly bent forwards; both surfaces glabrous, margin and apex glabrous to ciliate; main vein starting marginally, not parallel to the upper margin, lateral veins inconspicuous to prominulous, not reticulate. description: A shrub with straggling branches or a woody climber; branchlets spiny, densely puberulous to tomentose, covered with dark glandular hairs, glabrescent. Stipules 1.2 by 1 mm, broadly ovate, acute, puberulous; leaves and panicles often found together on short shoots in the axils of old leaf scars. Leaves: rachis 3–8.7 cm; petiole 0.5–1.5 cm; gland 0.4–0.7 cm above the base, at or below the middle of the petiole; pinnae 8–11 pairs, 1.1–4 cm, glands between the junctions of the 4–6 distal pairs; leaflets 17–44 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, (2.5–)3–5.5 by (0.8–)1.3 mm, oblong; base asymmetrically truncate; apex acute and sometimes mucronate, slightly bent forwards; both surfaces glabrous but margins densely ciliate; main vein marginal at the base running submarginally but not parallel to the upper margin towards the apex, lateral veins prominent, anastomosing, reticulate. Inflorescence: peduncles panicled or solitary to paired in the upper leaf-axils. Flowers in heads, floral bracts 1 mm, spoon-shaped. Ovary 1 mm, velutinous; stipe 1 mm. Pod ca 2 cm broad, slightly inflated, tightly curled, greenish-grey, chartaceous, glabrous, with prominulous veins and marks over the seeds; dehiscent? Seeds ca 6 by 4.5 mm, broadly ellipsoid, biconvex, brown, pleurogram ca 3 by 1 mm, oblong.

description: Deciduous shrub or small tree up to 5 m high; branchlets tomentose, stipular spines up to 4.5 cm, shoots dimorphic, long and short; young leaves and peduncles crowded on the short shoots. Leaves: rachis (2.5–)3–9 cm; petiole 0.6–1 cm; gland just below the junctions of the proximal pair of pinnae, distal gland (s) 1–2, below the junctions of the distal pair (5) of pinnae; pinnae 7–23 pairs, 0.9–2.5 cm; leaflets 12–50 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 1.7–3 by 0.4–1 mm, oblong; base truncate/ cuneate, asymmetrical; apex obtuse with slightly scarious margin; both surfaces faintly to densely puberulous; main vein slightly excentric, nearly parallel to the margins, lateral veins inconspicuous. Inflorescence peduncles not panicled, axillary, bearing the involucel at or below the middle. Flowers in heads; floral bracts ca 0.9 mm, spathulate, tomentose. Calyx 0.9–1.2 mm, tube adpressedly puberulous to tomentose; teeth 4–5, 0.1–0.2 mm, triangular, acute, tomentose. Corolla 3.2–3.5 mm, tube glabrous; lobes 4–5, 0.9–1 mm long, ovate to ovate-elliptic, acute, with long hairs at the apex. Stamens more than 40. Ovary 0.8–1 mm, glabrous, sessile (stipeless than 0.2 mm). Pod ca 9–11 by 0.8–1.0 cm, linear-falcate, brownish, slightly convex, with parallel margins; coriaceous-chartaceous, faintly puberulous, with prominulous, longitudinal 1 parallel veins, With distinct marks over the seeds; dehiscing along both sutures. Seeds 6.5–9 by 5–5.5 mm, ellipsoid to oblong; flat, ca 1.5 mm thick; pleurogram up to 7 by 2.8 mm, oblong.

description: Straggling shrub or woody climber; branchlets spiny, ± densely puberulous to tomentose, brownish–greyish, ± glandular hairy. Stipules 1.5–3.5 by 0.5–1.5 mm, linear to ovate-lanceolate, tomentose to woolly, early caduceus. Seeds filling entire cavity of pod, ca 1.5 cm diam; central seeds ca 1.2 cm thick, discoid, terminal seeds up to 1.5 cm high, turbinate-truncate, slightly compressed; testa black, thin, crustaceous.

description: Differs from var. clypearia in the following characters: Calyx ca 3 mm with teeth 0.5–1 mm, triangular. Corolla 10–11 mm with lobes ca 5 mm, lanceolate, acute.

description: Tree ca 8 m high; branchlets terete with a few scattered hairs, glabrescent. Leaves: rachis 8–21 cm, gland(s) 2–5 cm above the base and often ca 2 cm below the junctions of the pinnae, up to ca 8 mm long and 3 mm high, urceolate to crater shaped, elliptic in outline; pinnae 1–2 pairs, up to 10–11 cm, gland between the junctions of the distal pair of petiolules, smaller but similar in form to the rachis glands; leaflets 3 pairs, petiolulate, opposite, thinly chartaceous, 6–24 by 3–9 cm, elliptic to obovate-elliptic; base asymmetrical, rounded to cuneate; apex shortly acuminate; both surfaces glabrous; lower surface with prominent veins, upper With prominulous lateral veins not forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: peduncles up to 4 cm, bearing a head of ca 25–30 sessile flowers. Calyx 3–4 mm, subtubular, faintly puberulous, especially along the margins of the inconspicuous teeth. Corolla 6.5–8 mm, narrowly campanulate, tube glabrous; lobes ca 3 mm, elliptic, acute, faintly puberulous. Staminal tube as long as the corolla-tube. Ovary 1.5–2 mm, glabrous; stipe 2.5–3 mm.

description: Small tree up to 10 m high; branchlets terete, faintly puberulous. Leaves: rachis up to ca 11 cm, gland ca 1 cm above the base, ca 0.5 mm diam., circular, flat, sessile, similar upper glands below the junctions of the two distal pairs of pinnae; pinnae ca 5 pairs, up to ca 15 cm, glands ca 1 mm below the junctions of the 2–3 distal pairs; of leaflets, up to 0.5 mm diam, circular, flat, sessile; leaflets 15–20 pairs per pinna, subsessile, chartaceous, 0.5–3.5 by 0.5–1.2 cm, trapezoid or nearly so; base half truncate, half cuneate; apex broadly acute to rounded, mucronate; both surfaces puberulous; main vein diagonal, upper surface with inconspicuous lateral veins; lower surface with prominulous ones not forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: peduncles ca 0.5 cm long, bearing “heads” of 2–3 sessile flowers. Calyx ca 1 mm, cup-shaped, glabrous with inconspicuous deltoid, puberulous teeth. Corolla ca 2.5 mm, campanulate, glabrous, with 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acute lobes. Staminal tube as long as the corolla tube. Ovary ca 1 mm, glabrous; stipe ca 0.5 mm. Pod up to 20 by 2 cm, compressed, spirally twisted in a circle, coriaceous, orange outside, reddish-orange inside, finely puberulous, dehiscing first along the ventral suture. Seeds dangling from a funicle after dehiscence, ca 8 mm diam., globose to ovoid, with a bluish–black testa, not occupying the cavity of the pod.

description: Medium–sized tree; branchlets terete, glabrous. Leaves: rachis 4–15 cm, glands ca 0.5 cm above the base and between the junctions of the pinnae, 3–4 mm, oblong, hardly raised; pinnae 2 pairs, 5–15 cm, glands between the junctions of the petiolules, ca 3–4 mm, obtriangular, flat, sessile; leaflets petiolulate, opposite, chartaceous, up to 20 by 9 cm, elliptic to obovate-elliptic; base rounded to broadly cuneate; apex bluntly acuminate; both surfaces glabrous; lateral veins prominulous on the upper surface, prominent on the lower, not forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: peduncles ca 1 cm bearing heads of 2–6 sessile flowers. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, broadly campanulate, faintly sericeous, with 0.5–1 mm, triangular teeth. Corolla 4.5–5 mm, campanulate, sericeous with 2–2.5 mm elliptic-lanceolate, acutelobes. Staminal tube as long as the corolla-tube. Ovary 1 mm, glabrous; stipe 1 mm. Pod forming a circle, 7–8 cm diam, 3–3.5 cm broad, compressed, coriaceous, yellowish outside, reddish-orange within, glabrous, without conspicuous veins, dehiscing along both sutuies. Seeds not filling the pod, dangling on a slender funicle, ca 10 mm diam. and ca 18 mm long, ellipsoid, with a bluish-black testa.

description: Small tree or shrub up to 5 m high; branchlets terete, more or less tomentose. Leaves: rachis up to 8 cm, glands ca 1–2 cm above the base and between the junctions of the pinnae, 0.5–1 mm diam, circular with slightly raised margins, sessile; pinnae 1–2 pairs, 2–6 cm, glands below the junctions of the petiolules, ca 0.5 mm diam., similar in form to the rachis–glands; leaflets ca 2–4 pairs, opposite, petiolulate, chartaceous, 3–10 by 1–3.5 cm, ovate to elliptic-lanceolate to sub-trapezoid; base rounded to broadly cuneate, slightly asymmetrical; apex acuminate, mucronate; upper surface glabrous except for the main vein, lower surface faintly puberulous with tomentose veins; lateral veins prominulous on upper surface, prominent on lower, not forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: peduncles up to 3 cm, bearing heads of 12–15 sessile flowers. Calyx ca 1.3 mm, campanulate, tomentose with ca 0.3 mm, triangular teeth. Corolla ca 4 mm, funnel-shaped, sericeous to tomentose, with 2–2.5 mm, elliptic, acute, patent lobes. Staminal tube as long as the corolla tube. Ovary ca 2 mm, glabrous; stipe ca 1.3 mm. Pod up to 12 by 1(–2) cm, compressed, contorted, forming a semi-circle to a circle, ca 4 cm diam, coriaceous, red-brownish outside, orange-red within, puberulous, glabrescent, dehiscing first along the ventral suture. Seeds not filling the pod, dangling from the funicle after dehiscence, ca 7 mm diam, ca 10 mm long, ellipsoid, with a bluish-black testa.

description: Tree up to 20 m high; branchlets terete, glabrous. Leaves: rachis 2–7 cm, gland (s) ca 0.5 cm above the base of the petiole and between the junctions of the pinnae, 1.5–2 mm diam., subsphaerical to flat and circular, sessile; pinnae 1 pair, up to 20 cm, glands (often absent) between the junctions of the petiolules, 0.75–1 mm diam., flat, circular, sessile; leaflets 2–3 pairs per pinna, petiolulate, opposite, chartaceous, up to 8–15 by 4–5 cm, ovate-elliptic to oblong; base broadly rounded to broadly cuneate, apex acuminate; both surfaces glabrous, lateral veins prominulous, not forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: panicles in the axils of the upper leaves, or below the leaves, at the leaf-scars on the older branches; peduncles ca 3 mm bearing heads of 4–7 sessile flowers. Calyx 1–2 mm, broadly campanulate to cup-shaped, faintly puberulous, with 0.25–0.3 mm, deltoid teeth. Corolla 4–5 mm, tube glabrous, with ca 2 mm ovate-elliptic acute, reflexed lobes with distinct veins, lobes faintly puberulous to glabrous. Staminal tube as long as the corolla tube. Ovary ca 1 mm, glabrous; stipe ca 2 mm. Pod: up to 20–25 by 4 cm, compressed, falcate or twisted in a wide spiral more or less deeply lobed along the ventral suture between the seeds, woody, greyish outside and inside, glabrous, dehiscent along the ventral suture. Seeds fill the pod, ca 35 mm diam., and 10 mm thick, biconvex, circular, with a dark brown, thin testa.

description: Tree up to 8–10 m high; branchlets terete, faintly puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves: rachis 1–10 cm, gland 0.5–2 cm above the base, less than 1 mm diam, circular, often with raised margins, sessile to slightly stipitate, similar gland 0.2–2 cm below the junctions of the distal pair of pinnae; pinnae 1–2 pairs, 8–15 cm, glands ca 0.5 cm below the junctions of the petiolules, smaller than but similar in form to the rachis glands; leaflets ca 4 pairs, proximal pairs often alternate, distal pair always opposite, petiolulate, chartaceous, (3–)7–10(–15) by 2–3.5(–4) cm, ovate to subtrapezoid to lanceolate; base cuneate often asymmetrical, apex acuminate to caudate; upper surface (dark When dry) glabrous, lower surface faintly puberulous to glabrous; lateral veins prominulous on the upper surface, prominent on the lower, not forming a dense reticulation. inflorescence, bearing heads of ca 15 sessile flowers. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, funnel-shaped, sericeous, with up to 0.3 mm, teeth triangular. Corolla 4.5–5.5 mm, funnel-shaped to campanulate, sericeous, with 1.5–2 mm, elliptic to ovate, acute lobes. Staminal tube slightly shorter than the corolla-tube. Ovary ca 1 mm, glabrous, stipitate; stipe 1 mm. Pod up to ca 20 by 2–3 cm, compressed, contorted to a semicircie or a circle, coriaceous, red-brownish outside and reddish orange within, glabrous, dehiscing along both sutures. Seeds not filling the pod, dangling from the funicles after the dehiscence, 8 mm diam, 12–13 mm long, ellipsoid with a smooth bluish-black testa.

description: Small tree up to ca 10 m high branchlets terete; glabrous (dark when dry). Leaves: rachis 0.5–1(–2) cm, gland(s) at the middle of the petiole and between the junctions of the pinnae, 1–3 mm diam, circular, flat, sessile, sometimes only the upper gland present; pinnae 1 pair, up to 14–15 cm, glands between the junctions of the petiolules, similar to the rachis glands, sometimes absent; leaflets 2–3 pairs, petiolulate, opposite, chartaceous 6–19 by 3–7 cm, elliptic to ovate-elliptic; base rounded to cuneate, symmetrical, apex acuminate; both surfaces glabrous; the lateral veins forming a dense reticulation. Inflorescence: peduncles 1–1.5 cm, bearing heads of ca 5–6 sessile flowers. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, subtubular to funnel-shaped, glabrous except for the 0.25 mm deltoid teeth, which are slightly puberulous along the margins. Corolla (3.5–)5 mm, funnel-shaped to campanulate, tube glabrous; lobes erect, 1.5–3 mm, ovate-elliptic, faintly sericeous at the apex. Staminal tube as long as the corolla tube. Ovary ca 2 mm; stipe ca 2 mm long. Pod up to ca 16–20 by 3 cm, compressed, falcate or contorted in a broad semicircle, often lobed along the ventral suture, firmly coriaceous, brownish-grey outside, reddish within, glabrous, with prominulous, reticulate veins especially over the seeds.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrubby tree up to 4–5 m high; branches terete, puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves: rachis 4–7 cm; glands between the junctions of the pinnae ca 0.5 mm diam, circular, sessile, concave with raised margins; pinnae 2–4 pairs, opposite, 3–6 cm; glands below the junctions of the leaflets, 0.1–0.2 mm diam, circular, sessile; leaflets 5–13 pairs per pinna, opposite, sessile, 1–1.5 by 0.3–0.7 cm, oblong (the distal pairs obovate); base asymmetrical, truncate behind, rounded in front; apex asymmetrically rounded, mucronate; both surfaces glabrous; main vein excentric, ca ⅓ of the width of the leaflet from the upper margins, 3–4 accessory veins ascending from the base, connected by prominulous lateral veins forming a reticulate pattern of venation. Marginal flowers: Calyx 2.5–3 mm, subtubular, glabrous; teeth ca 0.3 mm long, triangular–deltoid, ciliate along the margins. Corolla 6.5–7 mm, funnel shaped, glabrous; lobes ca 2 mm, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, ciliate at the margins and faintly adpressedly puberulous in the outer part (2 of the lobes may be united higher up). Staminal tube shorter than or as long as the corolla tube. Ovary sessile, glabrous. Pod up to 20 by 2–3 cm, segmented, ca 1 cm broad between the segments. Seeds ca 10–12 by 10 mm, suborbicular-obovate, ca 2 mm thick, flat, brown; areole ca 2.5 by 0.8 mm, oblong, the pleurogram not parallel to the margins.

description: A caespitose shrub with trailing or climbing branches. Leaves: petiole 1.8–4 cm, rachis 4.5–10 cm long; leaflet–bearing pinnae 2 pairs, (15–)4–8(–14.5) cm, leaflets (0.8–)1.2–4 by (0.2–)0.5–1.7 cm, elliptical to broadly oblong, apex truncate, emarginate, mucronulate; lower surface not glaucous. Spikes 7–12 cm Long, rachis densely puberulous to velutinous. Flowers subsessile; pedicels up to 0.5 mm. Calyx (1.8–)2–2.5 mm, cup-shaped to campanulate, glabrous or with a few patent hairs. Petals 4.5–5(–5.5) mm, lanceolate, acute, often with 2 parallel linear 1.5–2 mm glands in the lower half of the dorsal side. Ovary (often reduced) ca 3 mm. Pod 2.2–2.6 cm broad and up to 35 cm long, curved, brownish, glabrous; segments ca 2.4 cm long and upto ca 2.6 cm broad; exocarp coriaceous with inconspicuous veins; endocarp chartaceous. Seeds 1.1–1.8 cm diam, subglobular with a brown, hard sclerotesta.

description: Woody climber. Leaves: petiole 3.5–7.5 cm; rachis (4.5–)6–8(–10.5) cm; leaflet bearing pinnae 2 pairs, 5–15 cm long; leaflets 34 pairs per pinna 2.5–7 by (1–)1.3–3.5 cm, obovate to elliptical lanceolate; apex ± acuminate to obtuse, ± emarginate to nearly bifid; lower surface not or very rarely glaucous. Spikes ca 13–25 cm, ± densely puberulous, with inconspicuously pedicellate flowers; pedicels 0.3 mm long. Calyx (0.5–)0.8–1 mm, broadly cup-shaped, glabrous or with a few scattered hairs. Petals 2.8–3–mm, narrowly elliptical to lanceolate, acute, eglandular. Ovary 1–1.5 mm (sometimes absent), glabrous, shortly stipitate; stipe 0.5 mm long. Pod 7–15 cm broad and up to 2 m long, straight to slightly curved; segments 6.5–7.5 cm long; exocarp woody; endocarp rigid, woody, 2–4 mm thick. Seeds 3.5–4 cm diam, up to 1 cm thick, subcircular, flat with a thick brown testa.

description: Woody climber. Leaves: petiole 2–4 cm; rachis (4.4–)5–8.5 cm; pinnae 2 pairs, 4–9 cm; leaflets 3–4 pairs, 1.8–6.5 by 0.9–3 cm, narrowly obovate elliptical to obovate, glaucous beneath; apex rounded–truncate, emarginate. Spikes 20 cm, rachis faintly puberulous to tomentose, with sessile to inconspicuously pedicellate flowers. Calyx 0.5–1 mm, cup-shaped, densely puberulous to glabrous. Pods large, spirally coiled, ca 6 cm broad and more than 20 cm long; segments indistinct; exocarp woody ; endocarp chartaceous, segmented. Seeds irregularly compress ed, 6–6.5 cm long, ca 5 cm broad, and 1.5–1.8 cm thick, with a hard, brown sclerotesta.

description: A large shrub or-low tree up to 10 m high. Leaves: rachis 15–20 cm long; gland often present below the junction of the proximal pair of pinnae, orbicular; pinnae 3–10 pairs, up to 10 cm long; leaflets 5–20 pairs, 6–21 by 1.5–5 mm, linear or linear-oblong; base slightly, obliquely cuneate, apex acute; both surfaces glabrous, margins ciliate, lower surface glaucous. Inflorescence peduncles 1–3 together, 2–5 cm long. Calyx ca 2.5 mm long, tubular-campanulate, glabrous at the base, puberulous at the apex, teeth tgiangular, acute, puberulous. Petals ca 4.5–5 mm long, spathulate, puberulous. Stamens 10, filaments 8–10 mm long. Ovary with hairy apex, stipitate. Pod up to 2 x 20 cm, strap-shaped, straight, flat, membranous, dehiscent. description: Scandent or prostrate shrub up to ca 1 m high, often with long whip-Iike, quadrangular, more or less herbaceous stems, armed with four rows of 3–4 mm long, recurved prickles. Leaves pinnately compound; petiole 3–5 cm long; rachis ca 6–11 cm long, sulcate, hirsute, without a straight thorn at the junctions of the pinnae, but armed with 4 rows of ca 1 mm long, recurved prickles on the internodes and stipellate thorns at the bases of the pinnae; pinnae 4–7 pairs, 1–4.5 cm long, hirsute, with a few recurved prickles on the lower surface; leaflets 12–21 pairs per pinna, (2–)3.5–5(–7) by (0.8–)1–2 mm, oblong, both surfaces with scattered hairs. Inflorescence peduncles solitary or paired in the axils of the distal leaves; ca 0.5–0.6 cm long, bearing heads of subsessile flowers. Calyx ca 0.4 mm long, inconspicuous. Corolla 2 mm long, narrowly funnel-shaped, finely puberulous; lobes 1 mm long, ovate, obtuse. Stamens 8. Ovary ca 1 mm long, inconspicuously puberulous. Pods clustered, 1.5–3.5 by 0.4–0.45 cm, oblong, slightly curved with short prickly bristles on the margins and surfaces of the valves.

description: Erect or scandent shrub up to ca 4 m high; branches distinctly woody. Leaves pinnately compound; petiole 0.8(–2.8) cm long; rachis 11–17 cm long, slightly angulate, densely strigose, armed with a straight, distally pointing thorn, ca 0.3–1.1 cm long at the junctions of each pair of pinnae; pinnae ca 10–14 pairs, ca 3.5–4.5 cm long, strigose; leaflets ca 45 pairs per pinna, 5.5–8.5 by 0.8–1.1 mm, linear-oblong, with strigose margins. Inflorescence: peduncles paired in the axils of the upper leaves, ca 2 cm long, strigose, bearing many-flowered heads of sessile flowers. Calyx ca 1 mm long, scarious, entire part ca 0.5 mm long, glabrous, distal part densely laciniate. Corolla 3 mm long, funnel-shaped, tube glabrous, lobes 1.2 mm long, elliptic-ovate, acute; glabrous in the proximal part, hirsute in the distal. Stamens 8. Ovary 1.5 mm long, densely velutinous. Pods several developed from the same head, ca 6 by 1 cm, linear-oblong, straight, beaked, densely scabrous; segments 0.2–0.3 cm long.

description: A low and often prostrate, annual or perennial herb up to 1 m high; branches more or less herbaceous. Leaves subdigitately compound; rachis (= petiole) (2.5–)3–5 cm, sulcate, hispid, without thorns at the junctions of the pinnae, but sometimes with a few recurved prickles on the interhodes; pinnae 2 pairs, (1.5–)2.5–6(–7) cm, hirsute; leaflets 12–25 pairs per pinna, 5–11 by 1.3–2 mm, oblong to subfalcate, upper surface glabrous, _lower surface and margins faintly hispid. Inflorescence: peduncles solitary or paired in the axils of the distal leaves, 2.5–3.8 cm long, hirsute, bearing heads of sessile flowers. Calyx less than 0.1 mm, inconspicuous. Corolla 1.9–2.3 mm, narrowly campanulate, lobes 0.5–0.8 mm broadly oblong-ovate, obtuse, rounded. Stamens 4. Ovary 0.3–0.6 mm, glabrous. Pods several, developed from the same head; 1.5–1.8 by ca 0.4 cm, oblong, straight, with setose margins.

description: Stipules 8–14 mm long. Heads in bud appearing ± densely bristly owing to setiform hairs projecting beyond the corolla for 1–1.5 mm. Corolla at least in bud ± densely grey puberulous outside in the distal part.

description: Stipules 4–7(–8) mm. Corolla glabrous or almost so outside, even in bud.

description: A perennial, terrestrial, prostrate herb with annual stems from a woody rootstock; stems up to 1 m, terete, not fistulose, glabrous. Stipules 2–3 mm, cordate, with caudate apex. Leaves: petiole 0.5–1.5 cm, gland rather inconspicuous, 0.2–0.4 cm above the base, sometimes in the lower half, sometimes in the upper; rachis (1–)1.8–3.2 cm, angular, glabrous or faintly puberulous; pinnae (1–)2–3 pairs, (0.8–)1.1–2.8 cm, winged, glabrous, but with ciliate margins, glandless; leaflets 7–20 pairs perpinna (1.8–)2–7 by (0.8–)1.2–2 mm, asymmetrically oblong, glabrous or rarely with ciliate margins; base truncate, asymmetrical, apex rounded to broadly acute, mucromate; main vein excentric, lateral veins prominulous, rarely much raised. Inforescence: peduncles ca 3–7 cm, usually without bracts, (bracts rarely present in the upper part), heads globose in bud; with 13–15 sessile flowers, subtended by ca 1.5 mm long ovate, acute bracts. Asexual flowers: Calyx 0.8–1.3 mm, cup-shaped, glabrous; teeth 0.4–0.8 mm, ovate, acute. Petals 1.8–2.3 mm, elliptical to lanceolate, acute. Staminodes ca 5–8 mm, linear-lanceolate, acute. Bisexual flowers: Calyx 1.8–2.5 mm, subcampanulate, glabrous, teeth 0.5–1 mm, ovate, acute. Petals 3–4 mm, elliptical to lanceolate-oblong, acute. Stamens 4–5.5 mm; anthers eglandular. Ovary sessile or subsessile, ca 2–2.5 mm, glabrous. Pod 3–5 by 0.5–0.9 cm, subfalcate to falcate, acuminate at both ends, flat, glabrous, chartaceus, dehiscent along the upper margin. Seeds ca 7–11, 3.5–4 mm long, 2–2.5 mm broad, ellipsoid, flat.

description: A perennial, aquatic, floating or rooting herb; stems up to 1.5 m long, fistulose, terete, founing a spongy–fibrous indument between the nodes and adventive roots at the nodes after having been detached from the primary root system. Stipules 4–8 mm, obliquely cordate, apex acuminate. Leaves: petiole 2.–4 pm, glandless; rachis 3.5–8 cm, angled, glabrous; pinnae 2–3 pairs, 2.5–6.5 cm, winged, glandless, glabrous, leaflets 8–18 pairs per pinna, (3–)4–10 by 1.2–3 mm, asymmetrically oblong, glabrous or with faintly ciliate margins; base truncate; apex obtuse to broadly acute often mucronate; main vein prominulous, lateral veins inconspicuous. Inflorescence: peduncles 12–30 cm, with caducous bracts, head obovoid in bud, 30–50-flowered. Asexual flowers: Calyx 0.9–1.5 mm, cup-shaped, glabrous; lobes 0.3–0.5 mm, ovate, acute. Petals 2.2–3.5 mm, elliptical, acute; staminodes 7–16 mm, linear, acute. Bisexual flowers: Calyx 2–3 mm, campanulate, glabrous; lobes 0.4–0.7 mm, ovate, broadly acute. Petals 3–4.3 mm, elliptical; acute. Stamens 6–8.9 mm, eglandular. Ovary 1.2–2 mm, glabrous, stipitate. Pod 1.9–2.8 by 0.8–1 cm, broadly oblong, flat, dehiscent along both sutures; stipe longer than the persistent calyx. Seeds 4–8, 4–5.1 by 2.7–3.5 mm, ovoid, compressed.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to ca 35 m high; branchlets puberulous. Leaves petiole 6–10 cm; gland 4–6 cm above the base, 4–6 mm long, broadly elliptic; rachis 34–55 cm; glands below the junctions of the 3–4 distal pairs of pinnae; pinnae (11–)14–20 pairs, (7–)12.5–14.5 cm long; glands below the junctions of the 7–9 pairs of leaflets, 0.5–1 mm diam., circular to elliptic; leaflets (20–)30–45 pairs per pinna, (8–)13–17 by (2.5–)3.2–4.2 mm linear-falcate; base sharply auriculate in the proximal part; apex acute, bent forwards; main vein starting central but soon becoming excentric, parallel to the front margin for most of its length; lateral veins prominent. Male flowers: calyx 9–9.5 mm, tubular; corolla 10.5–11.5 mm, tubular, lobes ca 1.5 mm, oblong, acute; staminal tube 9–9.5 mm; anthers 1–1.5 mm. Bisexual flowers (not observed). Pod immature ca 33 by 3 cm, straight conspicuously swollen over the seeds. Seeds obliquely horizontal ca 15–17, 17 by 12 by 6.5 mm, ellipsoid, with hard testa.

description: Tree up to 30 m high; branchlets puberulous. Leaves: petiole 2.2–6 cm, gland (s) 0.7–1.5 cm above the base, 2–4 mm, elliptical to circular; rachis 18–30 cm, glands between the junctions of the 0–4 distal pairs of pinnae, ca 1–2 mm diam, circular to elliptic; pinnae 14–18 pairs, (3.5–)5–9 cm, glands below the junctions of the 1–3 distal pairs of leaflets (rarely below all), 0.1–0.2 mm diam., circular; leaflets (18–)31–38 pairs per pinna; (5–)6–9 by (1.5–)1.8–2.2 mm, linear; proximal part of base expanded into an apiculate auricle; apex rounded, mucronate, straight; main vein central (rarely sub-central); lateral veins prominulous on lower surface. Male flowers: calyx 6 mm, funnel-shaped; corolla 7.5–8.5 mm, sub-tubular, lobes 1–1.1 mm, triangular-ovate, acute; staminal tube 7–8 mm. Bisexual flowers: (not observed). Pod: 36–45 by 3–5 cm, usually strongly twisted, prominently swollen over the seeds. Seeds: horizontal in the pod, 22.5–25 by 15–20 mm, orbicular, with thin testa.

description: Tree up to 35 m high; branchlets faintly puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves: petiole (3.5–)5.5–8 cm; gland 1–1.5(–1.8) cm above the base, (3–)4–6 mm, elliptic; rachis 13–30 cm, 1(–2) inconspicuous glands below the junctions of the terminal pair (3) of pinnae; pinnae (3–)5–12 pairs, (6.7–)10–15 cm, glands below the junctions of the 1–3 distal (rarely below all) pairs of leaflets, 0.3–0.7 mm diam, circular-elliptic; leaflets (8–)12–27 pairs per pinna, 10–28 by 3–10.5 mm, oblong; base not auriculate behind; apex truncate-rounded, often emarginate, straight; main vein slightly excentric, nearest to the front margin and in most instances nearly parallel to it for its whole length; lateral veins prominent. Male flowers: calyx 7 mm, narrowly funnel-shaped; corolla 8–9 mm, tubular; lobes ca 5.5 mm, linear, acute; staminal tube ca 6–7 mm long, anthers ca 0.8 by 0.5 mm. Bisexual flowers: calyx 11 mm, tubular; corolla 12 mm, tubular; lobes ca 8 mm, linear, acute; staminal tube 7–8 mm, anthers 0.5–2.0 mm; ovary 4 mm, appressedly puberulous. Pod ca 1.9 by 48 cm (incl. stalk) straight or slightly twisted, rarely twisted, swollen over the seeds. Seeds obliquely longitudinal ca 10 (immature) probably 11 by 20 mm, thin black testa.

description: Tree up to 50 m high; branchlets puberulous. Leaves: petiole (3–)5.5–11.5 cm, gland.3–3.3 cm above the base, 3.5–5 mm, elliptic; rachis (16–)30–40 cm, glands just below the junctions of the 2–3(–7) distal pairs of pinnae (rarely absent), 2–3 mm diam., subcircular; pinnae (14–)22–33 pairs, (2.3–)7–11.5 cm long; glands just below the ca 5–6 distal pairs of leaflets, ca 0.5 mm diam., circular; leaflets (15–)60–70 pairs per pinna, (2.5–)6–7 by (1–)1.5–1.8 mm, linear-falcate; base only inconspicuously auriculate in proximal part; apex acute, bent forwards; main vein starting centrally soon becoming excentric, nearly parallel to the front margin of the leaflet; lateral veins inconspicuous prominulous. Male flowers (not observed). Bisexual flowers: Calyx 7–9 mm, narrowly tubular. Corolla 85–11 mm, tubular; lobes ca 2 mm, narrowly oblong, acute. Staminal tube up to 12 mm. Ovary ca 1.5 mm, glabrous. Pod 22–28 by 3.3–4 cm, straight, inconspicuously swollen over the seeds. Seeds horizontal in pod, ca 20, 18.5 by 11 by 4.5 mm, ellipsoid, slightly biconvex with a hard black, thick testa.

description: Tree or shrub up to ca 10 m high; branchlets terete, faintly puberulous, glabrescent. Stipular thorns ca 0.4–1 cm. Leaves: rachis ca 1–2.5 cm long; gland between the junctions of the pinnae, ca 0.25 mm diam, circular, substipitate with slightly raised margins; pinnae 1 pair, up to ca 0.75 cm, armed with terminal, small, 1–2 mm, stipellate thorns; gland similar to the petiolar gland between the junctions of the leaflets; leaflets 1 pair, opposite, sessile, 1.5–3.5 by 1–2 cm, asymmetrically ovate; base obtuse, asymmetrical; apex obtuse, emargiate; chartaceous; both surfaces glabrous. Calyx ca 1.5 mm, cup-shaped, tomentose, teeth 0.3–0.4 mm, triangular. Corolla ca 3.5 mm, funnel-shaped, tomentose; lobes 1 mm, ovate, acute. Staminal tube as long as the corolla-tube. Ovary 2–3 mm, puberulous; stipe 1 mm. Pod forming a circle to semicircle, ca 4–5 cm diam, 1 cm broad, compressed, coriaceous, dark brown, glabrous, with distinct marks over the seeds, dehiscing along both sutures; inside reddish. Seeds with the funicle gradually thickening into a fleshy aril, covering the lower half, ca 9 by 7 mm, asymmetrically obovate, flat, ca 2 mm thick, dark; pleurogram up to ca 7.5 by 3 mm.

description: Spiny tree or shrub up to ca 5 m high; branchlets triangular or quadrangular, glabrous. Stipular thorns 0.5–2 cm long. Leaves: rachis 1–3 cm long, with wings up to ca 0.5 cm broad; gland between the junctions of the pinnae, ca 1 mm diam; circular, substipitate to stipitate; stipel ca 0.5 mm, often stipellar thorns atthe distal end of the rachis; pinnae 1 pair; ca 2 cm, with wings ca 0.3 cm broad, with similar glands between the junctions of the leaflets; leaflets 1–3 pairs, opposite, sessile; chartaceous, 2.5–6 by 1.4–2.5 cm, somewhat asymmetrical, obovate to elliptic; base asymmetrically rounded to cuneate, apex abruptly acuminate, mucronate. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, cup-shaped, glabrous; teeth 0.5 mm, triangular, acute. Corolla ca 6 mm, campanulate, glabrous; lobes ca 2 mm, slightly unequal in size, ovate, acute, glabrous. Staminal tube as long as the corolla-tube. Ovary ca 1 mm, glabrous; stipe 1.5–2 mm. Pod up to ca 20 by 2 cm, straight to slightly contorted, compressed, indistinctly jointed, slightly constricted between the seeds, chartaceous-membranous, brownish, glabrous, dehiscing separately over each joint. Seeds ca 13 by 10 mm, broadly ellipsoid, without aril, biconvex, ca 3 mm thick; pleurogram parallel to and about 2 mm from the margin.

description: Large spreading tree up to ca 20 m high; branchlets puberulous to tomentose. Leaves: rachis ca 15 cm; gland (s) just below the junctions of the proximal pair of pinnae, and below the distal pair, or below all the pairs per pinnae, leaflets 2–10 pairs per pinna, 1.5–6 by 0.7–4 cm, obliquely ovate to elliptic to sub-rhomboid; base asymmetrical, rounded behind, truncate in front; apex obtuse-rounded, often emarginate, mucronate; upper surface glabrous, lower surface densely puberulous; main vein diagonal; lateral veins forming a prominent, dense, reticulate pattern. Central flower sessile. Calyx 8–9 mm, broadly tubular, tomentose-woolly; teeth 7–8, 0.5–1 mm, triangular, acute. Corolla ca 1.2 cm, tubular, glabrous below, tomentose woolly above. Staminal tube longer than the corolla. Ovary glabrous, sessile. Marginal flowers pedicellate. Calyx 5–7 mm, funnel-shaped, tomentose to woolly; teeth 0.5–1 mm, broadly triangular, acute. Corolla ca 10–12 mm funnel-shaped, nearly glabrous in the lower part, tomentose to woolly above; teeth ca 2 mm long, triangular-ovate. Staminal tube shorter than the corolla tube. Ovary sessile, glabrous. Pod 15–20 by 1.5–2.3 cm, oblong, black. Seeds ca 9 by 5 cm, elliptic, strongly biconvex, 4 mm thick; areole ca 7 by 3 mm, elliptic.

description: Tree to 35 m high; branchlets densely tomentose, lenticellate soon glabrescent. Leaves: rachis 16–34 cm long, nearly glabrous to reddish tomentellous; petiole 4.5–10 cm, gland 0.5–2.5 cm above the base, 1–4 mm in diam., long circular to elliptic, flat or slightly sunk into the rachis; pinnae 7–10 pairs; leaflets 2 by 6–18, (8–)12–29 by 6–13 mm, trapezoid, base very strongly asymmetrically truncate, apex broadly rounded, asymmetrical, often emarginate; both surfaces glabrous; main vein starting submarginally at the lower margin, running diagonally across more than the middle third of the leaflet; lateral veins prominent, reticulate. Flowers: pedicellate, pedicels 2–10 mm long. Calyx yellow to yellow-brown, 11–15 mm, (cylindrical-) obconical, tomentose. Corolla yellow to yellow-brown, 23–32 mm, funnel-shaped, woolly. Stamens white to ca 50 mm long, tube only slightly exceeding that of the corolla. Ovary sessile glabrous. Pod 5.5–18 by 3.8–5.8 cm, oblong, sometimes slightly twisted, woody, glabrous, margins slightly raised. Seeds 12.5–14.5 by 6–7.5, mm, regularly to irregularily elliptic, biconvex; areole 9.5–12 by 2–4 mm, oblong, with pleurogram open towards the hilum.

description: Tree up to ca 25 m high, deciduous; bark greyish to reddish with small lenticels; branchlets terete, densely puberulous, glabrescent. Stipules ca 3 mm long, filiform. Leaves: rachis (= petiole) (1.5–)3–6(–7) cm long, tetete, puberulous to tomentose, glabrescent; gland at the junction of the pinnae 1–3 mm diam. ; pinnae 1 pair (7–)10–30 cm long, slightly sulcate, tomentose, glabrescent; gland just below the junction of the petiolules ca 1–2 mm diam; leaflets 3–6 pairs per pinna, with petiolules 2–3 mm long, 3.8–14 by 2.4–6.7 cm, ovate to broadly elliptic (rarely lanceolate); upper surface glabrous; lower surface puberulous to velutinous, rarely glabrescent. Inflorescence: peduncles 2.5–9 cm long, bearing heads of ca 90 sessile flowers subtended by 2–3 mm long, spoon-shaped bracts. Flowers: Calyx 2.9–4 mm long, funnel-shaped, tomentose to woolly, teeth 0.8–1(–1.3) mm long, triangular-ovate, acute. Petals 3.5–4.6 mm long, narrowly oblong, acute, puberulous to tomentose. Stamens 5–12 mm long, anthers eglandular. Ovary 2–2.5 mm long. Pod 12–17 by 3.5–6 cm, slightly shaped as a boomerang, tardily dehiscing from the apex along both sutures, red-brownish. Seeds ca 7–10, ca 11 by 7 mm, ellipsoid, flat.
